title: Effect of anti-inflammatory diet on inflammatory markers , oxidative stress , disability, fatigue and quality of life in relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis patient
index_summary: Study aim: Effect of anti-inflammatory diet on inflammatory markers, oxidative stress, disability, fatigue and quality of life in relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis patient Design: In this clinical trial with parallel groups , 120 eligible relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis patients will be chosen.Then participants will randomly divided to intervention and control groups and a code will be assigned to each of them Settings and conduct: Intervention group , antiinflammatory diet based on antiinflammatory diet pyramid and control group will received healthy diet recommendations.This study will be conducted in MS research center affiliated to Shiraz University of Medical Sciences. Participants/Inclusion and exclusion criteria: Age 20-40 years; EDSS <5.5; Voluntary cooperation; Clinical course of relapsing-remitting; Use of a particular diet during the last 3 months before entering the study Intervention groups: Relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis patients Main outcome variables: Change in disability score ( EDSS) ; change in fatigue score (MFIS) ; change in quality of life ( MSQOL-54 ) ; change in IL17 ; change in IL4 ; change in hs-CRP
